text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky had a flawless run in the 
Satsuki Sho. She then declared that she 
would give it her all from her position as 
the one to beat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Maruzensky run, Special Week and 
Grass Wonder spoke of their desire to 
chase after her back and catch up—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To live up to those expectations, 
Maruzensky smiled and resolved to deliver 
her absolute best performance in the 
Japanese Derby.
